Metadata.name: Jump Quest
Metadata.content: Jump Quest is a classic 2D side-scrolling platformer featuring Pippo, a vibrant adventurer navigating whimsical environments with precision jumping and exploration. Keyboard controls (arrow keys for movement and spacebar for jump) are customizable. The game’s UI consists of a Main Menu (Start Game, Options, Exit), an in-game HUD displaying lives, coins, power-ups, and a timer (if applicable), plus a Pause Menu for in-game actions. Core game mechanics include physics-based jumping, combat via stomp attacks and power-ups, resource management through coin collection, level transitions, scoring systems with bonus and high score features, scripted events that reveal hidden passages, breakable blocks, and dynamic challenges that increase as players progress.

Game.description: This root element outlines the game’s high-level structure, encapsulating core components such as mechanics, UI/HUD systems, and input/control systems.

Mechanics.Description: Game mechanics are methods invoked by game agents to interact with the game state. This includes movement, combat, resource management, level transitions, scoring, progression, and scripted events.

Mechanic.Name: Basic Horizontal Movement
Mechanic.Description: Pippo moves left and right using the arrow keys for navigation.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Maps left/right arrow keys to update Pippo's x-coordinate with a defined speed.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if keyPressed('left') then pippo.x -= speed; if keyPressed('right') then pippo.x += speed

Details.Purpose: Enable smooth lateral movement.
Details.Function: Listens to key events and changes Pippo's position accordingly.
Details.Implementation: Integrates with the physics engine for consistent movement; minimal dependency on other systems.
Details.Interactions: Directly interfaces with the Keyboard Input component in the InputControlSystems.

Mechanic.Name: Physics-Based Jumping
Mechanic.Description: Implements a jumping mechanic using physics principles, incorporating momentum and gravity for precision jumps.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Utilizes a physics engine to apply an upward impulse when spacebar is pressed and continuously applies gravity. The jump height varies based on the duration of the jump key press.

Details.Purpose: Allow Pippo to navigate vertical obstacles and platforms.
Details.Function: Initiates an upward impulse followed by gravitational pull to simulate realistic jumping.
Details.Implementation: Depends on the Physics Engine to calculate forces; checks input duration for variable height.
Details.Interactions: Relies on the Keyboard Input system and interacts with Collision Detection to determine when landing occurs.

Mechanic.Name: Variable Jump Height
Mechanic.Description: Allows higher jumps when the jump button is held longer within a brief time window to create a variable arc.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Monitors the duration of the spacebar press and applies additional upward force until a maximum threshold is reached.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if keyHeld('space') and within_jump_window then increase upward force

Details.Purpose: Provide players with nuanced control over jump height.
Details.Function: Adjusts the jump force dynamically based on the time the jump key is held.
Details.Implementation: Utilizes a timer to measure key hold duration and applies additional force incrementally.
Details.Interactions: Works in tandem with the Physics-Based Jumping mechanic and the Keyboard Input system.

Mechanic.Name: Stomp Attack
Mechanic.Description: Pippo defeats enemies by stomping on them while descending, which also triggers a bounce effect.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Checks if Pippo’s vertical velocity is downwards at the moment of collision with an enemy. If so, flags the enemy as defeated and modifies Pippo’s velocity for a bounce.

Details.Purpose: Enable combat by utilizing environmental physics.
Details.Function: Uses downward motion as a trigger for defeating enemies and bouncing off them.
Details.Implementation: Called within the game loop on collision events; depends on physics calculations.
Details.Interactions: Interacts with Collision Detection and the Physics Engine to ensure proper response.

Mechanic.Name: Power-Up Enhanced Combat
Mechanic.Description: Activates enhanced combat abilities such as temporary invincibility or increased damage when a power-up is active.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Upon collection of a power-up, Pippo’s combat attributes are temporarily modified until the power-up expires.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if collision(pippo, power-up) then apply powerUpEffect; if powerUpEffect active and collision(pippo, enemy) then enemy.defeated = true

Details.Purpose: Provide temporary battle advantages to the player.
Details.Function: Modifies player attributes and integrates with enemy collision logic.
Details.Implementation: Triggers attribute updates and a timer to revert changes after a set duration.
Details.Interactions: Works closely with the Collectibles and Power-Ups System and Collision Detection.

Mechanic.Name: Damage and Invulnerability Frames
Mechanic.Description: After taking damage, Pippo becomes temporarily invulnerable to prevent rapid consecutive hits.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: On collision with an enemy, if not already invulnerable, reduces Pippo’s life and then activates an invulnerability timer.

Details.Purpose: Prevent unfair rapid damage accumulation.
Details.Function: Flags Pippo as invulnerable for a short period after taking damage.
Details.Implementation: Integrates timer logic to reinstate vulnerability after expiration.
Details.Interactions: Works with the Life Management mechanic and Collision Detection system.

Mechanic.Name: Coin Collection
Mechanic.Description: Pippo collects coins scattered throughout levels to increase his score and potentially earn extra lives.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Collision detection triggers coin collection, increments the score, and removes the coin from the scene.

Details.Purpose: Reward exploration and navigation through levels.
Details.Function: Detects contact with coin objects and updates game state accordingly.
Details.Implementation: Relies on proper collision checks and score management routines.
Details.Interactions: Interfaces with the Score Tracker and Level Renderer to update visual elements.

Mechanic.Name: Power-Ups Management
Mechanic.Description: Handles the pickup and timed activation of power-ups such as Speed Hats, Bounce Boots, or Shield Caps.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Activates the power-up effect upon collision, starts a timer, and reverts the effect upon timer expiration.

Details.Purpose: Enhance gameplay by temporarily modifying player abilities.
Details.Function: Monitors collision events with power-ups and manages temporary effect duration.
Details.Implementation: Depends on both collision detection and a timing mechanism to revert boosts.
Details.Interactions: Integrates with the Combat Mechanics when enhanced combat is required and with the Save/Load System to persist temporary states if needed.

Mechanic.Name: Life Management
Mechanic.Description: Tracks Pippo's remaining lives and triggers a game over state when lives deplete.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Monitors damage events and decrements the life counter; signals the Game State Manager if lives reach zero.

Details.Purpose: Ensure game progression is halted upon player failure.
Details.Function: Updates and maintains player life count during gameplay.
Details.Implementation: Works closely with Damage and Invulnerability Frames and the Game State Manager.
Details.Interactions: Communicates results to the Game Over state handler and UI systems displaying lives.

Mechanic.Name: Level Transition
Mechanic.Description: Manages the shift between levels after objectives are met, handling asset unloading and reinitialization.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: On reaching the level's endpoint, loads the next level, resets Pippo's position, and prepares new assets.

Details.Purpose: Progress the game narrative and challenge scaling.
Details.Function: Triggers level unload and load routines.
Details.Implementation: Integrates with the Level Loader and Progression Controller.
Details.Interactions: Directly interacts with the Game State Manager and Level Management System.

Mechanic.Name: Pause and Resume
Mechanic.Description: Allows players to pause gameplay, freezing all active processes, and resume from the paused state.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Displays a pause overlay and interrupts active timers and animations. Resumes game state when prompted.

Details.Purpose: Offer players control over the game pace to manage interruptions.
Details.Function: Freezes and resumes game logic including animations and timers.
Details.Implementation: Works by halting the update loop; reactivates processes upon resume.
Details.Interactions: Communicates with the UIHUDSystems (Pause Menu) and Input Control Systems to detect pause/resume commands.

Mechanic.Name: Game Over State
Mechanic.Description: Handles the end-of-game scenario by triggering a game over screen when Pippo's lives are fully depleted.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Switches the game state to GAME_OVER and presents options for restarting or exiting the game.

Details.Purpose: Conclude the game session and prompt player decision.
Details.Function: Invokes game over routines and displays relevant menus.
Details.Implementation: Uses the Game State Manager to halt gameplay and transition UI elements.
Details.Interactions: Notifies UIHUDSystems for game over display and Save/Load systems for final state persistence.

Mechanic.Name: Real-Time Score Tracking
Mechanic.Description: Continuously updates the player's score based on coin collection and level completion.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Monitors scoring events and dynamically updates the score display.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: on coin collection: score += coin_value; on level complete: score += level_bonus

Details.Purpose: Provide immediate feedback on player achievements.
Details.Function: Listens to game events and updates numeric displays accordingly.
Details.Implementation: Integrates with the HUD for live updates and high score management routines.
Details.Interactions: Interacts with Resource Management and UI systems.

Mechanic.Name: High Score Management
Mechanic.Description: Tracks and stores the highest scores achieved to encourage replayability and competition.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Compares the current score against a stored high score and updates it if a new record is set.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if current_score > high_score then high_score = current_score

Details.Purpose: Foster competitive play and replayability.
Details.Function: Maintains persistent records of score achievements.
Details.Implementation: Reads and writes to a persistent storage system; integrates with the Save/Load Manager.
Details.Interactions: Works with the Score Tracker display and Save/Load systems.

Mechanic.Name: Time-Based Bonus Scoring
Mechanic.Description: Rewards players with additional points based on how quickly they complete levels.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Calculates a bonus from the remaining time using a multiplier and adds it to the overall score upon level completion.

Details.Purpose: Incentivize faster level completion and high replay value.
Details.Function: Determines bonus score based on a time formula.
Details.Implementation: Uses level timer data and integrates with the scoring system.
Details.Interactions: Synchronizes with the Level Loader and Score Tracker systems.

Mechanic.Name: Sequential Level Unlock
Mechanic.Description: Progresses players to subsequent, more challenging levels in a linear fashion.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Upon level completion, updates progression data and unlocks the next level for play.

Details.Purpose: Ensure a consistent and gradual increase in difficulty.
Details.Function: Manages level availability and unlock status.
Details.Implementation: Integrates with both the Level Loader and Progression Controller.
Details.Interactions: Notifies UI elements and Save/Load systems to record progression.

Mechanic.Name: Checkpoint System
Mechanic.Description: Saves player progress at designated positions within levels to allow respawning upon failure.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Records Pippo’s status and position when a checkpoint is reached, and restores it upon death.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if player reaches checkpoint then save current_position; if player dies then respawn at last checkpoint

Details.Purpose: Reduce player frustration by offering a midway save point.
Details.Function: Captures and stores game state at key intervals during a level.
Details.Implementation: Depends on a persistent memory system; integrates with the Game State Manager.
Details.Interactions: Works with Level Management and Save/Load Systems to store checkpoint data.

Mechanic.Name: Replay and Score Improvement
Mechanic.Description: Allows players to replay levels to improve scores, discover missed secrets, and earn higher rewards.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Stores the best score for each level and provides an option to replay levels from level select or post-level screens.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if player selects replay then load level with best score displayed

Details.Purpose: Encourage skill improvement and exploration.
Details.Function: Retrieves saved level records and prompts the replay option.
Details.Implementation: Works in tandem with the UI and Score Tracking systems.
Details.Interactions: Interfaces with the Level Loader and UIHUDSystems for displaying replay options.

Mechanic.Name: Scripted Event Triggering
Mechanic.Description: Executes predefined events (such as hidden passage activations or breakable block interactions) when certain conditions are met.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: An event manager monitors specific triggers and executes corresponding scripted actions in the game.

Details.Purpose: Enhance game narrative and interactivity.
Details.Function: Detects scripted triggers and initiates event actions accordingly.
Details.Implementation: Relies on real-time event polling and state checking; integrates with level geometry.
Details.Interactions: Interacts with Level Loader and UI components to display event outcomes.

Mechanic.Name: Environmental Hazard Activation
Mechanic.Description: Activates dynamic hazards (e.g., falling platforms, spikes) when the player enters designated danger zones.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Triggers hazard animations and collision checks when Pippo enters specific areas marked as dangerous.

Details.Purpose: Create environmental challenges that test player reflexes.
Details.Function: Monitors player position relative to hazards and triggers appropriate responses.
Details.Implementation: Uses collision detection and pre-set hazard triggers within level design.
Details.Interactions: Works with the Physics and Collision System to ensure timely activation and resolution.

Mechanic.Name: Secret Discovery
Mechanic.Description: Rewards exploration by unveiling hidden passages or bonus areas that yield extra rewards.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: Invisible triggers are placed in the level, and upon detection, reveal secret areas and grant bonus rewards.

Details.Purpose: Encourage thorough exploration and reward inquisitive play.
Details.Function: Detects collision with hidden triggers and alters the level layout to expose bonuses.
Details.Implementation: Couples with Collision Detection and Level Management to ensure secrets are revealed correctly.
Details.Interactions: Interacts with the Score Tracking and Power-Ups systems to apply rewards.

Mechanic.Name: Breakable Blocks
Mechanic.Description: Allows players to break certain blocks that may reveal coins or power-ups.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: When Pippo collides with or attacks a breakable block, a breaking animation is triggered and, based on the block's configuration, a coin or power-up is released.

Details.Purpose: Add an extra layer of exploration and reward.
Details.Function: Integrates with collision detection and attack mechanics to identify and process breakable blocks.
Details.Implementation: Uses scripted triggers and state changes to manage block destruction and item release.
Details.Interactions: Works with the Resource Management Mechanics (Coin Collection and Power-Ups Management) for item spawning.

Mechanic.Name: Time Trials Challenge
Mechanic.Description: Introduces an optional challenge where players must complete a level within a target time to earn bonus rewards.
Mechanic.Implementation_Details: At the start of a level, a timer is initiated. If the level is completed with time remaining above a target threshold, a bonus reward is applied, and the bonus is added to the score.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if level_complete and time_remaining > target_time then apply bonus reward

Details.Purpose: Motivate speed-run style gameplay and add replay value.
Details.Function: Monitors level timer and evaluates performance against a preset target time.
Details.Implementation: Integrates with the Level Transition and Score Tracking systems.
Details.Interactions: Works with Real-Time Score Tracking and Level Management to award bonuses appropriately.

UIHUDSystems.Description: The interface layer displays essential game information including lives, coins, power-ups, and timer, and provides the navigational menus: Main Menu, HUD, and Pause Menu.

SubSystem.Name: Main Menu
SubSystem.Description: Provides options for Start Game, Options, and Exit. Serves as the game’s primary entry point.
SubSystem.Implementation_Details: A simple, intuitive menu with clickable buttons and keyboard navigation. Integrates with the Game State Manager for state transitions.

Interaction_Details.Purpose: Guide players into entering the game.
Interaction_Details.Function: Handles user selections and dispatches events accordingly.
Interaction_Details.Implementation: Uses button event handlers and sound cues from the Audio System.
Interaction_Details.Interactions: Directly interacts with InputControlSystems and Game State Manager.

SubSystem.Name: HUD
SubSystem.Description: Displays real-time gameplay information such as Pippo's lives, coin count, current power-ups, and timer (if applicable).
SubSystem.Implementation_Details: A dynamic overlay updated in real-time based on game events and state changes.

Interaction_Details.Purpose: Provide constant feedback on game status.
Interaction_Details.Function: Updates display elements during gameplay when receiving events like coin collection or damage taken.
Interaction_Details.Implementation: Links with the Score Tracker and Life Management mechanics for live data.
Interaction_Details.Interactions: Works closely with the Mechanics systems and is refreshed by the Game State Manager.

SubSystem.Name: Pause Menu
SubSystem.Description: Offers options to resume, restart, change settings, or return to the Main Menu during gameplay.
SubSystem.Implementation_Details: An overlay interface triggered on pause, halting game updates and providing navigational choices.

Interaction_Details.Purpose: Allow players to interrupt gameplay in an organized manner.
Interaction_Details.Function: Pauses active timers and animations, suspending the game until resumed.
Interaction_Details.Implementation: Integrates with the Game State Manager to freeze and resume game logic.
Interaction_Details.Interactions: Interfaces with InputControlSystems to detect pause/resume inputs and with Audio System for feedback sounds.

InputControlSystems.Description: This system captures user inputs and maps keyboard event data to in-game actions such as movement and jumping. It also supports real-time customization of input configurations.

SubSystem.Name: Keyboard Input
SubSystem.Description: Handles arrow keys for movement and the spacebar for jumping, mapping these inputs to game actions.
SubSystem.Implementation_Details: Directly maps key events to gameplay functions and supports real-time updates via configuration changes.

Interaction_Details.Purpose: Bridge between user commands and game mechanics.
Interaction_Details.Function: Monitors and processes key events and dispatches them to the relevant game subsystems.
Interaction_Details.Implementation: Relies on event listeners and integrates tightly with movement and jump mechanics.
Interaction_Details.Interactions: Works with the Custom Configurator and the Game State Manager for seamless input handling.

SubSystem.Name: Custom Configurator
SubSystem.Description: Allows players to customize their control mappings in real time through an intuitive settings interface.
SubSystem.Implementation_Details: Provides a UI for remapping keys, immediately updating the Keyboard Input configuration.

Interaction_Details.Purpose: Enhance game accessibility and player comfort.
Interaction_Details.Function: Captures new key settings and propagates changes to the input handling system.
Interaction_Details.Implementation: Connects with persistent storage to save changes and applies them instantly upon confirmation.
Interaction_Details.Interactions: Works directly with Keyboard Input and Save/Load and Configuration System to ensure settings persist.
